nouns.it.notes: Pronouns bind through source paragraph antecedents, not the last dynamically evaluated value. Separate generic-action argument rules also apply.

nouns.input.notes: Inputs name ordinary Function parameters or native signature metadata. They do not introduce process stdin/argument transport.

nouns.output.notes: Runtime member access requires a compiler-resolved process target. Output is finalized raw stdout; Error has its own lifecycle and diagnostic boundaries.

nouns.error.notes: Runtime member access requires a compiler-resolved process target. Output is finalized raw stdout; Error has its own lifecycle and diagnostic boundaries.

nouns.list.notes: Typed owned Lists construct, append, replace and read indexed values; heterogeneous construction infers Thing without coercion. Indices and complete element types are checked. Iteration/removal remain outside this API.

nouns.dictionary.notes: This lexical category must be distinguished from similarly named compiler representations. Read the construction and native-lowering boundaries at the semantic target.

nouns.null.notes: Explicit Null initializes an absence value and prints null. It is distinct from an unassigned slot and from internal None/Unknown states.

nouns.thing.notes: Explicit Thing boundaries retain concrete runtime types; typed reads validate full element, shape and callable identities. No implicit coercion or dynamic arithmetic.

nouns.text.notes: The configured text root is a source spelling. Its storage and executable support are documented independently; the handler description below is not a callable API.

nouns.number.notes: The configured number root is a source spelling. Its storage and executable support are documented independently; the handler description below is not a callable API.

nouns.byte.notes: The configured byte root is a source spelling. Its storage and executable support are documented independently; the handler description below is not a callable API.

nouns.truth.notes: The configured truth root is a source spelling. Its storage and executable support are documented independently; the handler description below is not a callable API.

nouns.pointer.notes: Managed typed handles share targets; reads snapshot ordinary contents. Checked mutation rejects ownership cycles, including container and callable-environment edges. No pointer arithmetic or raw-address API.

nouns.op.notes: This lexical category must be distinguished from similarly named compiler representations. Read the construction and native-lowering boundaries at the semantic target.

nouns.func.notes: Function declarations retain typed signatures and use the canonical builtin definition. Their invocation verbs participate in ordinary sentences.

verbs.passive.notes: Assignment follows resolved typed-storage rules and definite assignment. Runtime ordering is preserved independently of parser retry order.

verbs.associative.notes: Association names an existing canonical value or definition. It does not create an independent runtime copy.

verbs.declarative.notes: A declaration associates a source name with the indicated category or value. Voice-specific recognizers do not imply interchangeable native behavior.

verbs.definitive.notes: Definition clauses establish source vocabulary or typed native-backed forms. Accepted construction and framing are bounded by definition expansion.

verbs.descriptive.notes: Descriptive clauses apply source-defined adjective/adverb meanings. Constructor descriptors preserve the target and source-unit ownership.

verbs.expansive.notes: Put appends to a List, stores Map values or replaces a Pointer target through checked runtime updates. It does not modify vocabulary Dictionaries.

verbs.locative.notes: Place replaces a List element at a checked Number index or a keyed runtime field. Required target/key/value types are checked.

verbs.receptive.notes: The configured word is recognized vocabulary, but no native outer collection instruction is supplied for this operation. Do not treat it as a supported general collection API.

verbs.reductive.notes: The configured word is recognized vocabulary, but no native outer collection instruction is supplied for this operation. Do not treat it as a supported general collection API.

verbs.generative.notes: Build is the runtime readiness operation. It is distinct from the CLI command that compiles native output.

verbs.executive.notes: Run launches the selected process. The grammar does not imply that every applicative category is runnable.

verbs.suspensive.notes: Await joins a selected process invocation and activates its continuation once. A parsed clause alone does not establish valid activation placement.

verbs.interruptive.notes: Stop requests termination without joining. Final output still requires the Await contract.

verbs.inflective.notes: Configured Import/Export handlers do not replace the supported Use import syntax and are absent from native outer instruction dispatch.

verbs.deflective.notes: Configured Import/Export handlers do not replace the supported Use import syntax and are absent from native outer instruction dispatch.

verbs.observative.notes: Show emits the resolved operand without Print’s added newline; Output reads are subject to process finalization.

verbs.terminative.notes: Exit ends the compiled program. Function-local Return uses the selected Function.Return definition and checked outputs.

verbs.appropriative.notes: The configured comparison/appropriation root is used in bounded condition forms. Operand types and Error-member restrictions are enforced by native lowering.

verbs.comparative.notes: The configured comparison/appropriation root is used in bounded condition forms. Operand types and Error-member restrictions are enforced by native lowering.

adjectives.visibility.public.notes: Public/Publicly marks exactly the associated declaration. It does not publish unrelated owners or sibling declarations.

adjectives.initialization.notes: Constructor/descriptor vocabulary determines source construction roles. Its presence does not imply arbitrary type construction or inherited native metadata.

adjectives.abstraction.notes: Constructor/descriptor vocabulary determines source construction roles. Its presence does not imply arbitrary type construction or inherited native metadata.
